attchmntText: The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'General Updates'.
sm_name: The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 11.52 crores for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, the loss after tax was 3.66 crores. Revenue from operations was 78.43 crores for the quarter and 145.97 crores for the six-month period. The board noted the resignation of Chief Financial Officer Mrs. Lalita Rajesh and Company Secretary Mr. Saghan Srivastava, effective 13th November 2026. Mr. Manoj Agarwal was appointed as the new Chief Financial Officer, effective 26th November 2026.
